results.title: Any pressure targeting people’s livelihood ‘part of war’
results.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 25 (MNA) – Lashing out at the US policies adopted towards the Islamic Republic, Iran's Acting Defense Minister Brig. Gen. Seyyed Majid Ibn Al-Reza has said any pressure that targets livelihood and security of the people is part of war.

results.title: VP Sara’s camp awaits court ruling on motion to quash NBI grave threats cases
results.description: The legal team of Vice President Sara Duterte said the court has heard oral arguments on its motion to quash the informations filed against her in connection with the National Bureau of Investigation's (NBI) grave threats cases, arguing that the court lacks jurisdiction while she remains in office. In a statement issued on Tuesday, Aug. 25, Atty. Paul Lawrence Lim, counsel for Duterte, said the motion is based on what the defense described as the “limited procedural immunity” granted to the Vice President and other impeachable officers under the 1987 Constitution. “We confirm that the Honorable Court heard the parties’ oral arguments on our Motion to Quash the Informations for lack of jurisdiction,” Lim said. He said the legal basis for the motion rests on the procedural immunity of impeachable officials while they are in office. However, Lim said the defense could not provide further details because the matter is pending before the court. “The matter being sub judice, we unfortunately cannot give further explanation,” he said. “We will now await the court’s resolution on our motion,” he added. The cases stem from the NBI's investigation into allegations of grave threats involving Duterte. A motion to quash generally asks a court to dismiss a criminal case on specified legal grounds, including an alleged lack of jurisdiction. The court’s ruling on Duterte’s motion could determine whether proceedings in the NBI grave threats cases may continue while she remains Vice President.
